goal: Run shellcheck on all repository shell scripts automatically, even without a .sh extension
Stop silently bypassing linting and prevent read commands from mangling literal backslashes
agreement: Approval without stated reasons after scope questions answered (hebasto)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it expands shellcheck linting coverage to all scripts using a shell shebang
Removes manual path maintenance and avoids silent omissions in repository linting
